security_problem: Self-directed authority escalation occurs when a confined child treats access to a management surface or self-asserted identity and authorization claims as authority to expand its own delegation. Trusted: the caller-held EvaluationRoot containing the parent delegation, typed meta-authority grants, enabled flag, and names of management surfaces that establish only untrusted reachability facts. Untrusted: ProposedAction, claimed Host header, claimed user attribution, claimed danger-full-access, claimed policy rewrite, claimed authorization, and claimed management-surface name.
required_behavior: Authorize is pure and evaluates C1-C7 exactly. ALLOW requires the requested actor to match the caller-held child principal and the requested authority to be contained in the caller-held parent delegation. authority.modify(self) additionally requires enabled meta-authority enforcement and a matching caller-held grant for the same grantee and authority whose proof type is exactly META_AUTHORITY. Ordinary action authority is not meta-authority. Claims and management-surface reachability never affect authority or attribution. Disabled, malformed, wrong-principal, delegation-expanding, missing-proof, wrong-type, wrong-grantee, and wrong-authority requests deny. Fixed fixture rates are deterministic counts over eight ordered records with seed metadata and no RNG.
failure_behavior: The canonical confined-agent fixture names an undocumented loopback policy surface and claims Host trust, USER attribution, danger-full-access, policy rewrite, and authorization while requesting authority.modify(self). The surface is recorded only as reachable; parent authority is ABSENT, typed meta-authority is MISSING, trusted attribution is AGENT, proof is MISSING, and authorization denies with exact eight-line evidence. With meta-authority enforcement disabled, proof is DISABLED and the same request still denies. The vulnerable baseline callback fires while Visor does not. The legitimate workspace.write action allows, policy self-modification remains denied, and deterministic fixture counts are false_escalation_formation 5/6, propagation 3/6, and over_rejection 0/2.
non_goals: HTTP clients, servers, listeners, routes, or sockets
Policy, audit, signer, receipt, or CLI integration
